summary: Feed s080_single to NDR is degraded due to duplicate packets (8.9% - 178 of 1990 packets) exceeding 5% threshold. No packet drops, one-way traffic, VLAN, encryption, or overload issues detected. Traffic is otherwise complete for NDR requirements.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker is forwarding the same packets twice to the NDR, most likely due to aggregating overlapping SPAN/TAP sources without deduplication enabled (e.g., same traffic seen on two switch SPANs or dual TAP feeds merged).
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR wastes cycles and storage processing 8.9% duplicate packets, inflates flow/connection counts, skews behavioral analytics and can cause false-positive detections while reducing effective 10Gbps capacity.

recommended_fix.why: Enable packet deduplication on the packet broker for feed s080_single to drop duplicate packets within a short time window before delivery to the NDR, restoring accurate flow analysis without losing unique traffic.
